explanation: Fires only at D1 in the last ~10 trials of the episode (trial 89 onward), and only while the agent keeps choosing a2 and the previous trial was rewarded after reaching S2: the first such rewarded D1 after an unrewarded trial (or after a rewarded rare trip to S1) is about 1-6, and a second rewarded D1 in a row is about 10, then it slowly fades to 6-8 if rewards keep coming. It is 0 everywhere else: at every GO and D2 step, at any D1 after no reward or after a reward reached through a rare transition, before about trial 89, and whenever the agent is choosing a1.
